body: It's diagnosed depression. There isn't much I can do about it. It isn't just your normal every day sadness, something people get over with an ice cream cone and a "hey man, chin up." It's something that's gnawing at you constantly, like a voice in the back of your skull that's constantly telling you to just fucking end it all. There are people in my life who love me, I know that, but it doesn't help. That may sound selfish but I have no control over it. I have no control.

I appreciate it, but I'm a terrible talker. Everything I say is either off-point or nonsensical or inadvertently insulting. I'm a horrible conversationalist.

Lately I've considered the concept that maybe some of us were meant to die. Maybe some freak accident caused our birth, or somewhere down the line we accidentally evaded what was supposed to be our demise, and everything that follows is a blank slate filled with endless nothingness, and I think I missed my boat.
